page.overview:
Who is Ninth?

Ninth is an infamous New World pirate captain who allied with Whitebeard.

Ninth is a tall man with dark hair and a scar on his forehead. He has long sideburns, a pointed nose and a rather long chin. His chest is exposed, and he has ruffles on his wrists.

Not much is known of Ninth's personality, other than that he was willing to fight to save Ace.

Ninth is a fearsome pirate who has managed to achieve an infamous reputation in the New World, and to make an alliance with Whitebeard.
